hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "${f#$d/}" in frontend/index.html) cd "$d" && python3 scripts/check_csp_hashes.py >&2 || exit 2 ;; esac; }

d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "${f#$d/}" in docs/*.md|AGENTS.md|frontend/styles.css|frontend/index.html|frontend/three-bg.js|frontend/js/*.js|frontend/tests/*.test.js|scripts/tests/*.test.js) cd "$d" && python3 scripts/check_docs.py >&2 || exit 2 ;; esac; }
